reputation.title: Reputation
reputation.description: Review score and count on Booking.com, last {days} days.
reputation.info: Read from search result pages already scanned, no extra scans. New reviews per month reflect how many guests stay. Booking score milestones: 7.0 qualifies for Preferred, 7.5 for Genius, 8.0 Traveller Review Award, 9.0 the “Superb” label.
reputation.changeTitle: Versus the start of the {days}-day window
reputation.emptyBody: Scores and review counts are read from search result pages. They appear after a few scans.

valueMap.title: Price versus score
valueMap.description: Listed-price index and score index versus the comp set median (100 = median).
valueMap.caveat: This is correlation, not causation: a price above the score level doesn't mean the price is losing guests, only that it's worth a look.
valueMap.empty: Needs both listed prices for the next 30 nights and a review score to compare.

visibility.title: Search visibility
visibility.description: Rank on the area's result pages in Booking's default order, last {days} days.
visibility.info: 1 = top of page 1. “Excluding ads” removes sponsored cards ranked above. Badges are the labels on the hotel card (Preferred, ad, deals…).
visibility.notSeen: Not seen on the result pages
visibility.emptyBody: Needs a market area (Settings › Market) and at least one scan of the area's result pages.
